heard: Your train is running four hours late, and the trip no longer works. Is your ticket money gone? Railway refund rules say if a train runs more than three hours late and you don't travel. You can claim the full fare with no cancellation charge. The catch, don't just press cancel. An hour before departure, that can return nothing. Instead, file a TDR online for the late train, before it actually leaves. Follow Courtlands for everyday Indian law explained.
